content.snl: variable(__list__(Type.annotation(@$\mathbb{K}$,Type),Type.annotation(@V,Type),LA.Field($\mathbb{K}$),LA.VectorSpace(V,$\mathbb{K}$),Type.annotation(@s,$\mathrm{Set}\ V$),Type.annotation(@t,$\mathrm{Set}\ V$),Type.annotation(@hs,$\mathrm{LinearIndepOn}\ \mathbb{K}\ \mathrm{id}\ s$),Type.annotation(@hst,$s \subseteq t$),Type.annotation(@ht,$\top \le \mathrm{Submodule.span}\ \mathbb{K}\ t$)),def(Module.Basis.extendLe(hs,hst,ht),,$\mathrm{Basis}\ (\mathrm{hs}.\mathrm{extend}\ \mathrm{hst})\ \mathbb{K}\ V \quad\text{with}\quad s \subseteq \operatorname{range} \subseteq t$))

values.zh-CN: `Basis.extendLe hs hst ht` 在张成集 $t$ 内把线性无关集 $s$ 扩充为基：它接受三个显式参数——独立性证明 `hs`、包含关系 `hst : s ⊆ t`、张成条件 `ht : ⊤ ≤ span 𝕂 t`，返回基 `Basis (hs.extend hst) 𝕂 V`，且 $s\subseteq$ 其底层族 $\subseteq t$。
values.en: `Basis.extendLe hs hst ht` extends the linearly independent set $s$ to a basis inside the spanning set $t$: three explicit arguments — the independence proof `hs`, the inclusion `hst : s ⊆ t`, and the spanning condition `ht : ⊤ ≤ span 𝕂 t` — yielding the basis `Basis (hs.extend hst) 𝕂 V` with underlying family between $s$ and $t$.
